head_commit.message:
Fix "archive conversation" on Windows

Addresses issue https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/3582 where an "archive conversation" command in the extension fails 100% of the time on Windows.

The underlying problem is that "archive conversation" renames / moves the JSON file associated with the conversation. On MacOS and Linux, this move can be done while the file is still open. On Windows, this fails. The file handle is open at this point because the logic was emitting a rollout shutdown but not waiting for the file to be flushed and closed. This race condition almost guarantees that the move will fail on Windows.

To fix this:
* Store the rollout writer task in shared async state so every RolloutRecorder clone can synchronize shutdown
* Record the spawned writer JoinHandle, allowing shutdown to await the background task
* Wait for the shutdown ack and then join the writer
* Makes the writer flush, acknowledge, and exit, ensuring the .jsonl handle is released before the archive rename runs
